summary:
By combining the visuals and audio, the tool helps visually-impaired people to have some degree of visual awareness of the world. We empathy with the visually-impaired and understand what they're going through so we developed this tool to help them notice the world visually. 

This tool is vital because visually-impaired get a chance to grasp and visualize what is going on in this planet via audio cues.
details: Our tool transforms visuals into audio. After you enter the website, the system automatically transforms the visual of the world there into the audio for the visually-impaired. Visually-impaired also recognizes our project via this tool. They can explore the world by the audio cues in our tool, this will greatly impact how they see the world. We used Python, Phycharm to code our website. To transfer codes into our website, we used StreamLit Community Cloud. Moreover, we got help from AI to generate audio. Our project is creative as we help people to feel what they can't by one of their senses.
